data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open hotel search, enter destination and pick a suggestion, choose dates, set guests with Increment, search/update, then sort or filter) with the right parameters; it loses a point because it models guests as a single count instead of rooms and guests, and it puts Search before the guest step and adds filters the user never applied. It is concrete enough to automate, with a minor gap in how the guest count maps to rooms.
